episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the current trends in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of understanding specific market segments and the role of AI in enhancing real estate services. She provides actionable strategies for pricing properties and maintaining client relationships, highlighting the need for personalized communication and the use of AI-generated visuals to enhance property presentations.
